commit.author: André Leite <leite@de.ufpe.br>
commit.message:
Restructure JOSS paper to the current required sections

JOSS now requires "State of the field", "Software design", "Research
impact statement" and "AI usage disclosure". The sidrar/ecosystem
comparison moves to State of the field, Design and implementation
becomes Software design (with the census example as a subsection), and
the two new sections are added. Also: ORCID for Marcos Wasiliew, date,
and thanks to the rOpenSci editor and reviewers.
